## Checklist

- [ ] The title and every commit are [conventional commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`...): a squash merge lands the title on `main`, a rebase lands each commit
- [ ] Behaviour changes come with a test that fails without them
- [ ] No secrets, personal data (project names, local paths, usage numbers, machine details) or captures that show them
